
            <h1 class="postTitle">
                <a id="cb_post_title_url" class="postTitle2 vertical-middle" href="https://www.cnblogs.com/uoky/p/19520921" title="发布于 2026-01-23 10:33">
    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">记：node 环境变量引发的问题</span>
    

</a>

            </h1>
            <div class="clear"></div>
            <div class="postBody">
                <div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body blogpost-body-html">
<div class="container">
<div class="section">
<h2 style="font-family: &quot;Segoe UI&quot;, Arial, sans-serif; color: rgba(44, 62, 80, 1); border-bottom: 2px solid rgba(52, 152, 219, 1); padding-bottom: 10px">前提条件</h2>
<ul style="margin-top: 15px; padding-left: 20px">
<li style="margin-bottom: 8px; font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; color: rgba(52, 73, 94, 1)">已安装node</li>
<li style="margin-bottom: 8px; font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; color: rgba(52, 73, 94, 1)">在卸载qwen的情况下，<code style="background-color: rgba(236, 240, 241, 1); padding: 2px 4px; border-radius: 3px; font-family: monospace">qwen -v</code> 依旧有输出</li>
</ul>
</div>
<div class="section" style="margin-top: 25px">
<h2 style="font-family: &quot;Segoe UI&quot;, Arial, sans-serif; color: rgba(44, 62, 80, 1); border-bottom: 2px solid rgba(52, 152, 219, 1); padding-bottom: 10px">问题描述</h2>
<div style="background-color: rgba(248, 249, 250, 1); padding: 20px; border-radius: 8px; border-left: 4px solid rgba(52, 152, 219, 1); margin-top: 15px">
<ul style="padding-left: 20px">
<li style="margin-bottom: 10px; font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; color: rgba(52, 73, 94, 1)">某日，在安装node一段时间之后，修改全局安装包的存储位置</li>
<li style="margin-bottom: 10px; font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; color: rgba(52, 73, 94, 1)">更新第三方插件qwen时，发现<code style="background-color: rgba(236, 240, 241, 1); padding: 2px 4px; border-radius: 3px; font-family: monospace">qwen -v</code>的输出，与实际github中release的版本号不一致</li>
<li style="margin-bottom: 10px; font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; color: rgba(52, 73, 94, 1)">这个问题发生了一段时间，但误以为是qwen更新时未同步调整versioncode的问题</li>
<li style="margin-bottom: 10px; font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; color: rgba(52, 73, 94, 1)">随着版本不断更新，发现qwen命令调用无法呼出cli ui窗口</li>
<li style="margin-bottom: 10px; font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; color: rgba(52, 73, 94, 1)">问题不断升级</li>
<li style="margin-bottom: 10px; font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; color: rgba(52, 73, 94, 1)">卸载qwen重新安装，但过程中发生了一个奇怪的问题：<strong style="color: rgba(231, 76, 60, 1); background-color: rgba(253, 242, 242, 1); padding: 3px 6px; border-radius: 4px">在卸载qwen的情况下，qwen -v依旧有输出</strong></li>
<li style="margin-bottom: 10px; font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; color: rgba(52, 73, 94, 1)">发现蛛丝马迹之后，使用<code style="background-color: rgba(236, 240, 241, 1); padding: 2px 4px; border-radius: 3px; font-family: monospace">where qwen</code>，得到当前qwen.cmd文件的绝对路径。发现与指定的全局安装包位置不符合</li>
<li style="margin-bottom: 10px; font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; color: rgba(52, 73, 94, 1)">于是立刻检查环境变量，发现原来默认的c盘的路径还在环境变量里</li>
<li style="margin-bottom: 10px; font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; color: rgba(52, 73, 94, 1)">这个问题一直存在，但并没有被发掘，直到引发了更多的问题，才被发现解决</li>
<li style="margin-bottom: 10px; font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; color: rgba(52, 73, 94, 1)">还好，发现蛛丝马迹就直接解决了</li>
</ul>
</div>
<div style="text-align: center; margin: 25px 0; padding: 15px; border: 1px dashed rgba(189, 195, 199, 1); border-radius: 8px; background-color: rgba(248, 249, 250, 1)"><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/2115870/202601/2115870-20260123095635360-234104023.png" alt="PixPin_2026-01-23_09-56-32" loading="lazy" style="max-width: 100%; height: auto; border-radius: 8px; box-shadow: 0 4px 8px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.1)"></div>
</div>
<div class="section" style="margin-top: 25px">
<h2 style="font-family: &quot;Segoe UI&quot;, Arial, sans-serif; color: rgba(44, 62, 80, 1); border-bottom: 2px solid rgba(46, 204, 113, 1); padding-bottom: 10px">解决方案</h2>
<ul style="margin-top: 15px; padding-left: 20px">
<li style="margin-bottom: 8px; font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; color: rgba(52, 73, 94, 1)">删除旧环境变量【默认的全局存储路径配置】</li>
</ul>
</div>
</div>
</div>
